results.reply_text: The customer is responsible for paying all import duties, taxes, customs fees, and any additional fees on international shipments once the order leaves Acha’s facilities (Acha sells under CIF terms, so their responsibility ends when the carrier collects the package). results.message: Do I get a discount for a large order?
expected_titles: If I place a large order, do I get a discount?
results.reply_text: Yes. Orders over USD 350 qualify for free DHL/UPS/FedEx shipping (some items are excluded and brokerage/import/duty fees aren’t covered). For larger orders there’s a tiered discount plus equal-value store credit: 3% discount + 3% credit for orders over USD 800; 5% + 5% for over USD 1,400; 7.5% + 7.5% for over USD 2,000; 10% + 10% for over USD 2,600; and 15% + 15% for orders over USD 5,000. Certain items (e.g., blister‑packaged or sterilized products, clamps, empty displays, needles) may be excluded from free-shipping eligibility.

expected_titles: Do you have a Money Back Guarantee?
Refund Policy
results.reply_text: We offer refunds for defective or unsatisfactory items if you contact us within 30 days of delivery and obtain a Return Authorization (RMA). Defective or damaged items may qualify for a partial refund, replacement, or store credit (we may request photos or require return for higher‑value items). If you’re unhappy with overall quality and return the items after receiving RMA and inspection, you can receive a full refund. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and in the original currency, use the exchange rate from the original payment date if applicable, and can take up to 24 hours once approved. Import taxes, duties, or brokerage fees are not refunded. Return shipping is generally the customer’s responsibility unless the item is confirmed defective; refused deliveries will have original shipping, return shipping, and any taxes deducted from the refund.
source_titles: Do you have a Money Back Guarantee?

results.message: What if the item I ordered is out of stock?
expected_titles: What if the item I ordered is out of stock?
results.reply_text: If an ordered item is out of stock, the store will notify you and offer these options: a refund to your original payment method (refunds can be requested within 30 days for defective or quality issues and are issued in the original payment currency using the exchange rate from the payment date; once approved a refund may take up to 24 hours to post), a substitution or replacement if you approve one, or a backorder where applicable. The store will contact you to explain availability and next steps (including whether a Return Authorization Number is required for returns). Note that import taxes, duties, and brokerage fees aren’t refunded, and shipping or return shipping costs may be deducted or remain the customer’s responsibility depending on the reason for the refund (for refused deliveries, original and return shipping plus taxes are deducted).
